projects.title: Municipal Data Query Performance
bullets: Wrote SQL aggregation and join queries for public municipal service tables as part of a supervised undergraduate course project.
Compared indexed and unindexed queries and documented query plans using SQLite within the course project.

research.title: Small-Image Classification
bullets: Loaded public small-image datasets and trained a compact image classifier using Python and PyTorch as part of supervised faculty research.
Summarized classification errors for small-image classification under input changes, working with public small-object image collections.

research.title: Bibliographic Data Query Performance
bullets: Wrote SQL aggregation and join queries for public bibliographic tables as a student research assistant under faculty supervision.
Compared indexed and unindexed queries using SQLite and documented query plans for research on public tabular data query performance.
